Evidence/XW-FMIIP-005
Evidence record

The FMIIP access-point target is not comparable with ATM, POS or agent counts

What does this evidence establish?

The 2030 target of 1,021 financial access points in the Financial Market Infrastructure and Inclusion Project (FMIIP), set against a January 2025 project baseline of 817 under the same project definition, cannot be added to or directly compared with ATMs, POS terminals or agents unless the project's access-point definitions and deduplication rules are documented.

What does it measure?

This record compares definitions and reports no new value: it sets the access-point baseline (817, January 2025) and target (1,021, 2030) of the Financial Market Infrastructure and Inclusion Project (FMIIP) beside administrative counts of ATMs, POS terminals and agents, and tests whether they measure the same thing.

Who or what does it apply to?

Access points as defined by the project, compared with administrative counts of ATMs, POS terminals and agents.

When was it measured or observed?

January 2025 project baseline / 2030 project target; 2025 administrative context

How current is it?

The project baseline refers to January 2025 and the target to 2030; the administrative counts compared refer to 2025. The evidence base holds no observed result against the target.

What this evidence does not establish

No valid way to add these measures together, or to compare them directly, is established. The 1,021 target has meaning only against the 817 baseline under the same project definition; the evidence base holds no result against the target, so no progress percentage can be calculated.

Method and verification detailDetail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

The project's indicator definition is compared with the definitions and counting bases of the administrative counts; because the project's access-point definitions and deduplication rules are not documented in the evidence base, no combined or comparable figure is produced.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference.
